entities.summary: Douglas Mason is a Canadian-Dutch professional ice hockey coach. He has been serving as head coach of the Graz 99ers in Austria since December 2016. His son Steve Mason is a professional ice hockey player. Doug Mason was a athletes & competitors from Greater Sudbury (b. 1955-08-20, Greater Sudbury).
